rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act - Notice Requirements for Tenancy Termination
rules.requirement: Landlords must provide tenants with a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement, delivered at the same time as the Notice to quit or Notice of non-renewal of lease. Landlords and foreclosing owners must also complete the Notice to Quit / Non-renewal of Lease Submission Verification Form using an online form to provide tenant contact information and upload a copy of the termination notice to the City.
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all landlords in Boston planning to end a tenancy agreement through Notice to quit or Notice of non-renewal of lease
rules.sanctions: 1st Offense: Warning; 2nd and Subsequent Offenses: $300 per day. Failure to submit required information may result in fine up to $300 per day. Violations do not halt the eviction process.
